items.title: Do not re-open #4296. Do not skip #2885 on dest-path. Do not make plan the critic seat.
Host (or equivalent adapter) lands process_only on Grok PreToolUse tool_input for general-purpose plus dest cwd. Regression exercises that stdin shape.
Unmarked dest-cwd general-purpose is never a critic seat: zero briefs is #2885; one eligible is implement-class dest-lock. Skip class distinguishes them.
Acceptance requires spawn-process-only-ready, no dest occupancy, no leftover file_scope. Zero, one, and multiple eligible briefs.
Implement-class never sets process_only. Implement-envelope conflict stays fail-closed.
grok CLI last-resort after any native outcome that is not skip-class. No dual-launch. Parent relay is not native completion.
Separate in-repo deliverable from any upstream xAI schema ask.
